title: Componentwise normalized coefficient evaluation projection
statement: Fix l, E, W and reduction data R with evaluation tensor normalization hE. For normalized M, n, any adjunction L ⊣ coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation n and P, and every q, the finite evaluation of the unit-defined projection is an isomorphism.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Proposition 4.17(a), component calculation before joint evaluation detection.

proof.text: Identify the actual evaluation tensor comparison with the normalized semilinear comparison on flat-term K-flat representatives using hE.
For q ≤ n, use scalar tensor reassociation followed by normalized reduction of M; for q > n, use the singleton extension vanishing and preservation of zero by tensor.
Transport the representative component isomorphisms through exact evaluation and the derived comparison to the displayed evaluated morphism.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientNormalizedEvaluationProjection_components
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (hE : CoefficientEvaluationTensorNormalization l E W R)
    (M : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W)
    (hM : IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l E W M) (n : ℕ)
    (L : normalizedDVRDerived l E W n ⥤ coefficientSequenceDerived l E W)
    (adj : L ⊣ coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n)
    (P : normalizedDVRDerived l E W n) (q : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W q).map
      ((adj.homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((R.finiteClosed n).tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom (adj.unit.app P)
              (𝟙 ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n).obj M))) ≫
          (R.evaluationTensor n).inv.app (L.obj P, M))))
